notes.title: Official Release Date Announcement & Patch Notes v0.5.2
notes.content:
Hello! This is Hoochoo Game Studios.

Official Release Date Announcement

Forest Heroes is officially launching this coming July!

The release version will include new hidden stages that can only be accessed by meeting specific conditions, along with unique gameplay mechanics tied to them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/56cb740185973dbfab88aac8957f96b775854aac.png

Steam Deck Support

You can now officially enjoy Forest Heroes on the Steam Deck!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/ef53e25094a6c4993a3230cb3ae838bead0327cb.png

Patch Notes - v0.5.2

Changes

Custom Key Binding Support

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/b3d9a4ee3e5181590f8c9a6dac58ebad1afb86fc.gif
You can now customize your key bindings in the Options menu to fit your preferences.
*Currently not supported on macOS. We plan to add support soon.

New Effects for Waiting Cards and Some Talismans

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/30cc6113bf0113d30c02ee11265ca2fa428c3c03.gif
– When using a standby card, an effect will appear on your hand based on the card’s ability.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/2367da6666704d9acd0429dffea7c890bb5b5474.gif
– Visual effects will now appear on the hand or screen when certain artifacts are activated.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would disappear after switching from the reward UI to the stage info UI and back.
 Fixed an issue where the movement speed effect could not be reapplied to a unit.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/77468e7539d813bd149b146c2d139eb18b24aad2.png
We’ll keep improving Forest Heroes leading up to the official July release.
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: 0.5.1 Patchnotes – Curse Effects Expanded
notes.content:
Changes to 15-Curse  
The previous 15-Curse increased only enemy ATK, which didn’t reflect the unique characteristics of each stage.  
Now, enemy Spikes, Poison, and other mechanics will also increase to better reflect each stage’s identity.

macOS Support  
We now support macOS! Although it has passed internal testing, please let us know if you encounter any bugs.

Changes  
• Shooter Marten: New effect  
• Ballista Tortoise: Exclusive artifact effect changed  
• Woodpecker: Now recovers HP equal to ATK  
• Hipe Hopes: Cost increased  
• Encouraging Feather: Cost increased

Bug Fixes  
• Fixed an issue where curse-related stat boosts were not properly applied to “created” enemies  
• Fixed an issue where the curse effect that increases shop prices didn’t stack correctly with the artifact “Club”  
• Fixed an issue in the “Rowdy Cave” event where artifacts like “Picnic Basket” did not refresh properly when units were removed or re-recruited  
• Fixed an issue where the artifact “Cracked Egg” did not trigger correctly with the Relentless Elf’s “Thrifty Hunting” skill

notes.title: 0.5.0 Patchnotes - A New Elf Has Arrived!
notes.content:
Hello, this is Hoochoo Game Studios.

New - The Relentless Elf  

A new elf joins the battle to protect Noctful Forest.  
Once a bird, she was shot by a hunter and died—but was resurrected as an elf with the help of other elves. She then found the hunter who shot her and made him her pet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/5c93cce6e0f1efb27c9442226d27a26275b83bec.gif

Her companion hunter, “Tom”, supports the battle using a unique mechanic called Bullet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/019601f45802084c829cc046fb7ef6579ca4b0fa.gif

The Relentless Elf takes flight from Tom’s head and dominates the battlefield. Cast powerful spells directly above enemies, and guide Tom’s bullets to high-priority targets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/99c6482ce5cf7cc5a1cc0d65eba6f7e5779b1851.gif

Rework - Pit of Betrayal  

Pit of Betrayal has been reworked to provide stronger effects.

Balance Changes  

• Puberty Monkey: Decreased ATK and HP  
• Mute Swan: Decreased Evasion  
• Ballista Tortoise: Fewer hits required, increased cost  
• Battle Reindeer: Effect changed  
• Entangled Spikes: Cost decreased

Improvements  

• Encyclopedia “Allies” tab now displays ally-only artifacts.

Bug Fixes  

• Fixed issue where artifacts triggered “at the end of combat” may not work on Stage 1  
• Fixed issue where stages could not start if deck had fewer than 4 cards  
• Fixed issue where unlock UI text might break or appear in the wrong language


We’re also sharing the updated roadmap reflecting the latest patch.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/25ed33eb4173654373e62a898c24a6d6a455f73b.png

Thank you!

notes.title: Forest Heroes Roadmap Update
notes.content:
Hello, this is Hoochoo Game Studios.

Today, we would like to share updates on the progress and revisions of the roadmap we shared during the Early Access launch.

Updated Roadmap

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/6129fa5bb3c69924638613ceb3bac24f7bdf53b1.png

First, the planned four new battle themes have been fully implemented, and the Oak Tree stage has been revamped with new enemies.

Additionally, although not originally planned, we have introduced an update adding over 40 new artifacts.

Instead of focusing on keybinding, we have decided that adding new content would be more beneficial for improving the experience and gathering feedback. As a result, the new unit additions originally planned for April will be moved up and included in the next patch.

Look forward to meeting new animal friends in Forest Noctful!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/0534b7fe27502a7d9c13256fc3b2043f2b7ccea1.png
*The Cobra has taken the purple color, and the existing Tentacle Snake’s color has been changed.

We will continue to work hard to ensure smooth progress on future updates. Thank you!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.3.0
notes.content:
Hello from Hoochoo Game Studios!

Major Updates

40+ New Artifacts Added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/112d2f5cb2de4430d300d3ae78c1ecffefbcfdcb.png
Based on the feedback we’ve received since the early access launch, we’ve decided to add a large number of artifacts. These additions aim to improve the following aspects of the game:

 Provide a wider range of victory plans and playstyles
 Offer more ways for your team to grow stronger
 Enhance the utilization of existing keywords (poison, bleed, stealth, etc.)

This large-scale addition was a challenging choice for both development and balancing, but we’re delighted to bring you a much richer experience. We have adjusted it so that an artifact is unlocked every time a curse is cleared.

Final Boss "The Oak" Reworked
The Oak was intended to be the ultimate challenge in early access, but its current skill set and unit usage up to stage 7 made it less threatening. We’ve reworked its skills and associated units to make the stage much more challenging and enjoyable.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/84c6cdc980589a671df1e3a3363dc80cbddf0922.gif
New Components

 New skill “The Pale Elf”
  - Void of Life
  - Dead-Card Pile
  - Condense
 New crown “Flask Crown”


Minor Updates

System Changes

 Fixed damage indicators have been added to some skills. Fixed damage ignores fortitude and evasion and is applied directly to the enemy.
 Some artifacts will no longer appear at stages that are too high or too low.


Ally Changes

 The charm duration of “Lurer Peacock” has been reduced.


Artifact Changes

 The effect of the artifact “Gold Flag” has been changed.
 The effect of the artifact “Delicious Cheese” has been changed.
 The artifact “Sandbag” now deals damage equal to the attack power of the “Stormer Mole.”
 The artifact “Snail Shell” has been changed from a boss artifact to a rare artifact.
 The effect of the artifact “Bubbles” has been changed.
 The mana gained from the artifact “Flute” has been reduced.
 The effect of the artifact “Chestplate” has been changed.


Skill Changes

 The cost of “Pale Follower” has been reduced.
 The health consumed and increased by “Infusion” has been reduced.
 The mechanics of the card “Buffer” have been reworked.
 The range increase provided by “Standstill” has been improved.
 “Rage” now deals fixed damage, and its additional scaling has been removed.
 The effect of “Wind Blast” has been changed.
 The cost of “Violent Shadow” has been reduced.
 The cost of “Trap of the Dead” has been reduced.
 “Trap of the Dead” and “Curse of the Dead” now affect areas.
 The mana provided by “Unearth” has been increased, and it now has an exhaust effect.
 “Desperate Charge” now deals fixed damage, but its damage has been reduced.
 The attack power increase from “Last Stand” has been reduced.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the exclusive artifact “Spoon” for the “Brave Baby Pig” was applied multiple times when continuing a game.
 Fixed an issue where the “Plant a Mine” skill created Fungus Mines that could remain on the field indefinitely.
 Fixed overlapping death triggers
 Fixed an issue where the artifact “Shovel” did not work properly.
 Multiple issues related to ally group HP bars have been resolved.
 Option save files are now excluded from Cloud Save.
 Fixed an issue where the game could not be launched if the save file was corrupted.

notes.title: 0.2.0.3 Patchnotes
notes.content:
✨ Major Changes ✨


 🌰 New Stage: Chestnut  
A new stage themed around chestnuts and Spikess.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/2b5b797fc8bcf7fc458d4a197dedd4be9afe2f25.gif


🔧 Keyword Adjustments & New Keyword: Bleed 🔧


 🧪 Poison  
Poison is a powerful theme that focuses on stacking damage but was too strong against melee allies due to its indiscriminate area attacks. The poison mechanic has been adjusted to maintain its delayed AoE fixed damage while reducing the damage dealt to large allies.

 🕵️‍♂️ Stealth  
Previously, stealth only prevented targeting but did not protect against area attacks. Now, stealth ignores all types of attacks (including their effects). As a unique player effect, we hope players will utilize it in creative ways.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/1aae762c5fb393853785c142d2adebf0b6f83318.png

 🩸 Bleed  
The new status effect Bleed was added alongside the Chestnut stage. Enemies with Bleed take fixed damage with every attack. Additional skills and artifacts related to Bleed are under development.


🎯 Difficulty Adjustments 🎯


 During early access, we received many feedback points regarding difficulty. We are adjusting difficulty to create an enjoyable experience.
 Current focus points:

 To address the variance in experience due to component appearances (artifacts, allies, skills), we adjusted appearance rates based on stage progression. Additionally, we are considering adding more fun relics at the common and uncommon levels seen early in the game.
 While making the curse lvl 0 more accessible to new players, we aim to keep high lvl curse challenging. Buffs for enemies in later stages will be strengthened.

 Note that these difficulty changes are not final and will continue to improve during early access based on your feedback.


⚙️ Fixes ⚙️

Respawn UI now displays the Mushtower health reduction when reviving elves.  
Indicators added to new node events unlocked by advancing curse stages.  
  

🐞 Bug Fixes  
  
Fixed an issue where Old Elf's skills "Finger Snap" and "Whistle" could fail to trigger properly when used immediately after ally cards.  
Fixed an issue where quickly playing skill cards in succession could result in ignored skill usage.  
Fixed an issue where Old Elf's skill "Bless" did not remove certain harmful effects.  
Fixed an issue where identical node events could appear on both sides.  
Fixed an issue where focus did not shift to the ally area during 8th stage boss UI focus transitions.

notes.title: Forest Heroes Q&A
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/1fab3fe02010fd24ee4c230afa2c797f9c45acd0.pngQ. Improvements to Basic Units like Squirrel/Raccoon

 In the Day 1 patch, we made slight buffs to the range of Squirrel and the health of Raccoon.

 However, Squirrel and Raccoon serve as a buffer that provides reasons to draw other cards and prevents the deck from changing too quickly.

 If these units perform well, there will be less reason to add units to the deck, and during internal testing, there were instances where the game proceeded entirely with Squirrel whenever it was buffed even slightly.

 Rather than buffing Squirrel and Raccoon uniformly, we aim to enhance their situational utility through dedicated artifacts, ensuring that players can't solely rely on them but can expect some growth potential.
    
     We plan to enable Squirrel to contribute in various ways to battles through dedicated artifacts.
     We will continue to buff Raccoon's dedicated artifacts while monitoring their performance, ensuring Raccoon does not overshadow other melee allies.
    



Q. Unit Balance

 We wanted a pool of units that can occupy various positions, including universally good units, units that excel in specific situations, units that need to be centered around a deck to perform well, and units that feel different at low and high curse levels.

 As a result, a variety of decks have emerged, but we understand that players feel that some units are too good or too bad. Here are a few examples:

 Battle Reindeer provides early tanking at low curse levels and durability through unit artifacts at high curse levels, but does not leave a good impression in other situations. 
We plan to improve this through the addition of dedicated artifacts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/f42185879185279010e3e730807e155d9b8a52f9.png
    
     Lemmings guarantees too much growth potential with a single card. It makes it easy to imagine the most complete deck in Forest Heroes before trying out various decks, so we must be cautious in nerfing it, but some nerfing is necessary.
     We understand the gap between a unit's potential, its numerical performance, and its feel, and reducing this gap is one of the primary goals of the early access period.
    
 We believe this is an area that needs significant improvement during the early access period. If any specific unit feels too strong or undesirable, please let us know through Discord or the Steam forums, and we will actively work on improvements.


Q. Card Reroll Feature

 We are preparing a patch that allows you to reroll for new options using Calm in Vaneka's shop, Yoradi's shop, and Seed when the available options are unsatisfactory. 
This patch will be released very soon.


Q. Improvements to the Oak Tree Boss

 Major changes to the Oak Tree are planned during the early access period.


Additional Information

 Russian language support is planned for this month.
